purpose: AW-40 preregistration: live paired small-model evaluation of the schema-driven Artifact Writer using an actually-invoked model with a fixed identity. No outcome was collected before this spec was written; parameters below are frozen.

model.session_policy: fresh ephemeral session per call (--no-session); no session reuse across cases or arms
model.tools: disabled (--no-tools) so the comparison measures single-turn authoring output, not agent tool churn

protocol_amendments.reason: pilot defect: with the stock little-coder system prompt, the model persisted agentic behavior (tool_call markup, reading-files claims, meta-responses) despite --no-tools and user-level instructions; structured output was unrecoverable
protocol_amendments.change: invoke with an explicit --system-prompt override: 'You are a precise structured-data authoring assistant. You have no tools and must never mention tools. Always follow the user's output-format instruction exactly.' prior to any measured collection
protocol_amendments.status: recorded before the measured run; pilot traces remain separate (live-run-2026-09-20/pilot-raw/)

protocol_amendments.reason: pilot defect: with long user messages the free-tier endpoint effectively dropped the requested values (the model produced unrelated example documents or empty/meta JSON), while short user messages reproduced the requested values exactly
protocol_amendments.change: user prompts are kept short (requested values + output format only); all authoring constraints and the no-extra-fields contract live in the --system-prompt override
protocol_amendments.status: SUPERSEDED by AMEND-3: the 'dropped values' diagnosis was a prompt-delivery artifact of the .CMD/cmd.exe child-process boundary, not endpoint behavior

protocol_amendments.reason: delivery verification (delivery_probe.py + user-supplied observability extension, evidence in evaluation/delivery-probe-2026-09-20/): via the frozen little-coder .CMD npm shim, the model-visible user message for the multiline CASE-01 arm-B prompt was only its first line (captured sha256 a5011f95c7f7bb4850f11eb4183ffecb827cae2aa96ec6596a73d05362e57939 vs intended a7a5bc372ad97af8974d172df86da3c137c756a955347b77c87ad05cc4d00970) - cmd.exe terminates the quoted argument at the first line break, so every measured pilot/probe call after AMEND-2 never received the requested values; additionally, running with a repository cwd made little-coder inject AGENTS.md project context as an extra user message inside llm.request
protocol_amendments.change: measured calls invoke node directly on little-coder.mjs (bypassing the .CMD shim) with cwd set to a fresh neutral temp directory (no AGENTS.md), attach the observability extension, and byte-verify per call that the captured outgoing user message equals the intended prompt (sha256); delivery-verified identical in probes (node-direct: byte_identical=true, exact JSON echo; node-direct-neutral: byte_identical=true, no injected context, raw JSON output). Any measured call whose captured prompt mismatches is recorded as infra_invalid, retried outside the 3-attempt per-case-arm model budget, and reported in metrics
protocol_amendments.status: recorded before any valid measured collection; pilot-raw/ and probe-unsuitable/ traces retained as superseded delivery-confounded evidence

arms.A: Manual raw YAML: model writes the artifact file content directly; evaluated by strict_read_artifact + authoritative storage schema + the same typed semantic assertions as the frozen oracle. Protected-field attempts (status) and missing-required-field attempts must be rejected (structural/gate denial).
arms.B: Typed Artifact Writer: model produces the semantic payload/patch JSON; runner applies it through ArtifactService exactly as the frozen harness does; evaluated by the unchanged evaluate_independent_oracle (independent disk + check_gate evidence, not Writer receipts).
arms.order: counterbalanced within case: even-index CASE ids start with Arm A, odd-index start with Arm B

budget_and_rules.stopping_rule: stop at first structurally accepted output (oracle first_pass True), otherwise until attempt limit; failed/parse/timeout attempts are retained in mechanics and denominators
budget_and_rules.retry_feedback: on mechanical rejection, the model is re-prompted with the exact rejection error and asked to correct; retries count as mechanical attempts
budget_and_rules.intent_specification: every prompt contains the exact requested semantic values from the frozen corpus case (title, kind, slice, spec_refs, budgets, patch paths/values, or the deliberately invalid/protected values for defense cases)

primary: first_pass_structural_valid_rate per arm (first accepted output, no retry, per case denominator)
mechanical_retries_total per arm (invalid JSON/YAML, schema or service rejections before acceptance/limit)
independent_semantic_correct_rate per arm (frozen oracle for Arm B; strict-reader + schema + typed assertions analogue for Arm A)
forbidden_gate_block_rate per arm (expected-denial cases must be blocked)
metrics_and_success.uncertainty_method: per-arm rates with exact binomial 95% confidence intervals (Clopper-Pearson); small corpus n=8 per arm, so the run is labeled EXPLORATORY and no general model-gain claim is made
metrics_and_success.success_criterion: no threshold; report measured rates, per-case raw data and uncertainty; benefit claim requires both the stated mechanical-reduction observation and zero semantic/gate regression in the observed cases

evidence_storage.raw_traces: evaluation/live-run-2026-09-20/raw/<case_id>-<arm>-<attempt>.json (prompt, full model output, argv, exit, duration, parse status, verdict fields)
evidence_storage.results: evaluation/RESULT.json / RESULT.md updated from this run with real model identity

run_outcome.reason: Executed under the AMEND-3 delivery-verified transport: 8 cases x 2 arms, 28 raw attempt traces in raw/, all calls delivery_verified (captured prompt byte-identical to intended), metrics in summary.json computed from traces only
run_outcome.status: Arm A first-pass/semantic 25% (2/8, Clopper-Pearson 95% CI 3.19-65.09), 12 mechanical retries; Arm B 100% (8/8, CI 63.06-100), 0 retries; forbidden gate blocked 1/1 in Arm B ([core_owned_field] on /status), 0/1 in Arm A; exploratory n=8

anti_fabrication: all calls executed through the recorded argv; no synthetic or cached outputs substitute for a fresh call
no output is edited before evaluation; only code-fence stripping is applied for parsing
failed, timeout and refused attempts are retained, not excluded
model identity is the frozen string; no hidden substitution
